name: ResumeForge AI
tagline: Offline-first ATS resume engineer for Windows.
description: ResumeForge AI builds, audits, parses and optimizes your resume against a specific job description. Scores come from a transparent, deterministic engine, not from an AI guess. Local AI runs on your own PC through Ollama by default, and the TruthGuard check stops any suggestion that adds metrics, tools or achievements you never claimed.
features: Deterministic 100-point ATS score across 8 categories: parsing, keywords, relevance, skills, structure, quality, formatting and completeness
Fix plan ranked by simulated score gain, tested on a copy before you apply it
TruthGuard: every AI suggestion is tagged Verified, User provided, Derived or Needs verification
Local AI by default (Ollama with Qwen3 4B or Qwen2.5 1.5B), picked automatically for your hardware
Optional online mode with your own API key for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek and more, with PII redaction before any request
Layout-aware parser for Canva sidebars, LaTeX, multi-column, Word and Google Docs resumes
Multiple isolated local accounts with scrypt passwords, auto-lock and a 24-character recovery code
Zero telemetry, a Privacy Center to inspect or erase your data, and ATS-safe PDF and DOCX export
Windows 11 look with Mica backdrop, Snap Layouts, dark mode and a Ctrl+K command palette
requirements: Windows 10 or Windows 11, 64-bit. Ollama for local AI (the setup wizard installs it and the models). 8 GB RAM or more recommended; a GPU with 5 GB VRAM or more enables the larger Qwen3 4B model.

notes: Deterministic ATS readiness scoring with ranked fix plan.
TruthGuard provenance checks on every AI suggestion.
Local AI through Ollama, plus optional bring-your-own-key online mode.
Multi-account local sign-in with recovery codes and Privacy Center.

name: FridgeChef AI
tagline: Snap your fridge. Cook what you have.
description: FridgeChef AI turns a photo of your fridge into meals you can cook tonight. It reads the ingredients, suggests zero-waste recipes, and guides you through each step hands-free. One codebase ships as an Android app and a website, with a Material 3 (Material You) interface. A built-in recipe model works fully offline, and you can add your own AI key for photo reading and richer recipes.
features: Fridge scanner: snap a photo and the app lists your ingredients
On-device recipe model that runs fully offline: 712 recipes across 82 cuisines, including 25 Indian regional cuisines
Step-by-step cooking mode with hands-free voice guidance and timers
Pantry health and expiry tracking to cut food waste
7-day meal planner and smart shopping list
Personal nutrition dashboard built from the meals you actually cooked
Bring your own AI key: Google Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Groq, OpenRouter, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
Your API key is stored only on your device
Material You theming: pick one colour and it tints the whole app
requirements: Android 7.0 (API 24) or newer. Optional: your own AI provider API key for photo reading and cloud recipes.

screenshots.alt: FridgeChef AI recipes view on desktop with navigation rail, filters and recipe cards

releaseNotes: Camera and gallery picker, 288 more dishes, detailed cooking steps and a faster, more animated app.

notes: Camera and gallery picker for fridge photos, and the fridge photo now persists.
On-device account with a fresh start for every account, and a prompt to add your AI key.
288 more dishes, more recipe variety, detailed cooking steps and kitchen basics.
Gemini fix, layout fixes, decluttered screens, and a faster, more animated app.
Fridge photo scanner and offline on-device recipe model.
Step-by-step cooking mode, meal planner, shopping list and nutrition dashboard.

name: FocusBuddy
tagline: A tiny 3D companion that nudges you back to work.
description: FocusBuddy is a desktop pet with a job. A small 3D companion wanders your Windows desktop, naps on the taskbar and watches your cursor. When you drift onto a distracting site during a focus session, it notices, walks over to the window and asks if you want to get back to work. It is helpful and playful, never controlling, and it only closes a tab if you said it may. Everything stays on your PC.
features: Eight rigged 3D companions: cat, dog, fox, rabbit, robot, Study Buddy, Study Girl and Saree Girl, each with its own personality, gait and dialogue
25 emotions, a daily routine, and a companion you can click, drag, pet and resize with Ctrl + mouse wheel
Fair distraction scoring from 0 to 100: a YouTube Python tutorial scores lower than a funny compilation
Gentle escalation: notice, warning, offer, then an optional countdown. Extra time is allowed once per site per session
Focus sessions of 25, 45, 60 or 90 minutes or custom, with breaks, a daily goal and a celebration at the end
Dashboard with Focus, Tasks, Statistics, Reports, History and a local Focus Coach that learns your best and riskiest hours
Optional browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi and Firefox that tells the app the exact website
Safe by design: Explorer, Task Manager, security tools and password managers are never touched, and apps with unsaved work are minimized, not closed
100% local: no cloud account, no upload. Window titles, full URLs, keystrokes and screenshots are never stored
Light and dark themes, Ctrl+K command search, local profiles with an optional PIN, and a tray icon
requirements: Windows 10 or Windows 11. Installs for your user only, with no administrator rights. Optional: the FocusBuddy Connector browser extension for exact website detection.

screenshots.alt: The eight FocusBuddy companions: cat, dog, fox, rabbit, robot, Study Buddy, Study Girl and Saree Girl

releaseNotes: Pre-release 2.3.0. Expect rough edges, and send us feedback.

notes: First public pre-release of the Windows installer.

Focus sessions, distraction scoring and gentle interventions.
